reviewer: assistant manual review; not independent or blinded
scope: All 32 pilot questions; original source tables and matching supporting text, published programs, and original thinking responses.
sensitivity_rule: Exclude eight pre-flagged ambiguous/reference-sensitive cases only in secondary sensitivity analysis; keep all 32 in primary original-label results.
caution: All eight flagged cases were original thinking failures; this is a post hoc robustness check, not a new unbiased benchmark or an independent gain.
